dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Do you have this T-shirt in gray?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. duː juː ˈhæv ðɪs ˈtiːʃɜːrt ɪn ˈɡreɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sorry, no. We have pink, purple, and brown.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈnoʊ. wiː ˈhæv ˈpɪŋk, ˈpɜːrpəl, ənd ˈbraʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Purple, please. Can I try it on?
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrpəl, ˈpliːz. kən aɪ ˈtraɪ ɪt ˈɑːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Oh, it's nice. I'll take it!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈoʊ, ɪts ˈnaɪs. aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt!
